pr_title: Fixed backspace behavior in serial interactive console.
pr_comments:
Also: stm/ is deprecated and should not be used any longer. Use stmhal/ instead.
Yes, please use stmhal/ from now on.  There is a much more sophisticated readline in that port (stmhal/readline.c).  I have added "== 8" for backspace to that version.
Thanks for the fix!
